1: Hm? What is it, Nymph? Need something?
2:
Hey, do you still have your old textbooks?
The ones from elementary school.
3:
Elementary school textbooks? I think I put
them in the closet, probably...
4:
This area got blown up once by traps and
whatnot, though... Hope they survived...
5: Traps...? How does that even happen?
6:
Stuff happened, all kinds of stuff... Oh!
Here they are. Looks like they made it
through okay.
9:
Here. The textbooks I used, every subject
from first grade to sixth grade.
10:
Huh... They're cleaner than I expected.
You didn't study at all, did you?
11:
Mind your own business. Anyway, why do you
need textbooks, of all things?
12:
Well... I thought it might be better to start
over from elementary school.
16:
You know it too, right? What a ridiculously
hopeless kid she is...
17:
Ah. Yeah, fair enough. She's as useless as
the hero of some old boys' manga.
18:
Right? If she stays like that, it's not just
bad for Delta, of course, but you guys and
the teachers at school...
19:
And above all, it's a pain for me! If people
think Angeloids are all weirdos like her,
that's a huge pain!
20:
...Grades aside, isn't "all weirdos" pretty
much spot on?
22:
N-No! Nothing! Don't worry about it! M-More
importantly... so is that it?
23:
You're gonna use my textbooks to teach
Astraea from the basics up?
24:
That's right. So, can I borrow these
textbooks?
29:
You might actually make a pretty good lady
teacher.
30: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
31:
No, see, when you think "lady teacher,"
you normally picture a grown-up older
woman with a bombshell body...
32:
But! A "pint-sized teacher" with a kiddie
body and a childish personality is also a
truly alluring lady teacher type!
33:
Nymph! You've got a talent for being that
pint-sized teacher! I'm the one saying it, so
it's gotta be true!
34:
...I don't need that kind of talent. Just
hurry up and lend me the textbooks.
38:
Or I guess you like looking after people.
Worrying that much about Astraea and all.
40:
L-Like I said before, it's not like I'm worried
about Delta or anything!
41:
I just don't want people lumping me in with
her! Never mind that, the textbooks, now!
44: Shut up! Just hand over the textbooks!
47:
Yeah, that's what I'm most worried about.
Okay, from first grade... Ugh! What is this?!
49:
The cover of this textbook is clean, but...
the inside is covered in doodles!
50:
Ugh! The other textbooks are full of
doodles too! What were you doing at
school?!
51:
Don't get so worked up. Everybody
doodles in their textbooks, right?
52:
Is that so? Seriously, what's wrong with
Downer kids...?
55:
The higher the grade, the more the doodles
get kind of... um... sketchy...
56:
What on earth is all this...? I mean,
seriously!
57:
What the heck are you drawing in your
textbooks?! That's filthy!
58: Wh-What?! B-But! I couldn't help it, right?
59:
Couldn't help it?! How could you possibly
not help drawing dirty doodles like these?!
60:
'Cause, see, textbooks have some
surprisingly stimulating words in them!
62:
Yeah. Like how the science book has
"Uranus," or the social studies atlas has
"Erromango Island"!
64:
Exactly! For an elementary school boy...
no, even for a middle schooler, that's way
more than stimulating enough!
65:
And on top of that, the music textbook has
stuff like "How to Properly Put the
Recorder in Your Mouth"!
66:
"Properly put it in your mouth," man?! Just
thinking about it is too much for me!
Muhuuu!
67:
..........So? And the result of you inflating
your delusions with that stupid phrase is...
69:
Don't call them hopeless! They actually
get better as I move up the grades, you
know? Look!
71:
See? They're getting a little more
realistic, right? And then...
72:
Whaaaat?! L-Like this? I mean, you drew it in
THAT much detail?
73:
And the really amazing stuff starts from
the second term of fifth grade! Look at
this!
75:
From here on, the variety and
expressiveness of my doodles improved by
leaps and bounds! Look! Like this!
76: No! Seriously! Cut it out already!
77:
Huh? But the sixth-grade textbooks are
way, way more amazing... In a way, they're
the culmination of six years...
78:
I don't want to see that culmination!
Actually, forget it! I don't need your
textbooks!
80:
Isn't it obvious?! If I made her study with
these...!
81:
Delta's already hopeless enough, and
she'd catch your stupidity on top of it!
82:
Get rid of those properly! Where nobody
can see them! Actually, just burn them!
83:
Things like that shouldn't be allowed to
exist in this world!
84:
..........Y-You don't... have to go that far.
That's six years of my life's path...
